_comment: Permission matrix, read at boot by core/policy/matrix.ts. Part of the Root of Trust: the agent loop cannot change this at runtime, and your own edits take effect after `muffin rot reseal` and a restart. The two deny lists may only grow — removing a shipped entry from them does nothing. `paramsMaxTaint` is the one ceiling here the file may also RAISE, not just lower (see core/policy/matrix.ts) — it gates model-chosen bytes in a URL's query/fragment or a search query, above which the owner is asked and everyone else is refused. Ships 2: tier 2 is your own disk, tier 3 is the outside world (web, search, MCP, forwarded content).
